contact.name: Paul Matsumoto
contact.evidence_quote: A coat that comes in for storage does not leave for anywhere. Cold storage, cleaning and glazing, repairs, restyling and rentals all happen at 3314 Livonia Ave, by people who work here full time. Paul Matsumoto, President, runs the house on the same principle Lowell started with. Preserving what already exists is central to our philosophy, not just repairing it after something goes wrong.
